s1.syndrome_frame: Progressive neurological decline with earache and headache
key_facts: 2 months of progressive right earache and headache
1 week of intermittent hallucinations and nonsensical speech
No obvious external ear canal infection
CT scan showed otitis media, mastoiditis, and local bone destruction in the right ear
Brain MRI showed extensive area of hyperintensity with compressed right lateral ventricle

raw.syndrome_frame: Progressive neurological decline with earache and headache
key_facts: 2 months of progressive right earache and headache
1 week of intermittent hallucinations and nonsensical speech
No obvious external ear canal infection
CT scan showed otitis media, mastoiditis, and local bone destruction in the right ear
Brain MRI showed extensive area of hyperintensity with compressed right lateral ventricle

shortlist.label: Anti-NMDAR encephalitis
shortlist.why_kept: Positive anti-NMDAR antibodies and clinical presentation of progressive neurological decline with hallucinations and nonsensical speech

shortlist.label: Mastoiditis
shortlist.why_kept: CT scan showed mastoiditis and local bone destruction in the right ear, consistent with patient's earache and headache

shortlist.label: Autoimmune encephalitis
shortlist.why_kept: Positive CSF anti-AMPAR1 antibody and clinical presentation of progressive neurological decline

shortlist.label: Candida meningitis
shortlist.why_kept: CSF next-generation sequencing positive for Candida tropicalis, although clinical significance is uncertain

shortlist.label: Temporal lobe abscess
shortlist.why_kept: Brain MRI showed extensive area of hyperintensity with compressed right lateral ventricle, which could be consistent with an abscess

raw.rationale: The presence of positive anti-NMDAR antibodies in both CSF and serum, along with symptoms such as hallucinations, nonsensical speech, and left-sided weakness, strongly supports this diagnosis. The patient's symptoms and positive antibody tests are characteristic of Anti-NMDAR encephalitis.

rejected.label: Mastoiditis
rejected.why: While the patient has mastoiditis, it does not fully explain the neurological symptoms such as hallucinations and left-sided weakness.

rejected.label: Autoimmune encephalitis
rejected.why: This is a broader category that includes Anti-NMDAR encephalitis, but the specific presence of anti-NMDAR antibodies makes Anti-NMDAR encephalitis a more precise diagnosis.

rejected.label: Candida meningitis
rejected.why: The presence of Candida tropicalis in CSF next-generation sequencing does not correlate with the clinical presentation and other laboratory findings that point towards an autoimmune cause.

rejected.label: Temporal lobe abscess
rejected.why: Imaging studies show heterogeneous enhancement in the dura and pia maters and an extensive area of hyperintensity, but the clinical and laboratory findings, especially the positive anti-NMDAR antibodies, are more indicative of encephalitis than an abscess.
